title: JFestive Bacon Lardon Wrap Cazuela
description: A festive turkish dish featuring buttery, crumbly bacon lardon wrapped in a sam- wrap and served in cazuela for a low-glycemic-friendly meal.
instructions: Slice bacon lardon into thin strips and lightly season with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and add butter. Add bacon lardons and cook until crispy, about 4 minutes per side.
Remove bacon from pan and let cool slightly before wrapping in sam- wrap leaves.
Place wraps in cazuela and top each with a small amount of low-glycemic ingredients mix to taste.
Bake for 15 minutes or until the wraps are heated through and golden brown on top.
